theme.name: NES
theme.rule: NES charcoal, gray and red. Do not inherit PS4 blue UI accents. Famicom entries retain their own packaging identity.

packaging.rule: Use a verified straight-on retail box front. Do not require black-box styling; NES packaging varies widely by era and publisher. Cartridge-label art, angled boxes, case photos, fan art and provisional art are not GOOD. Famicom titles use verified Famicom retail packaging rather than synthetic NES conversions.

notes: Source platform IDs must be verified before automated recovery/fetching is enabled.
Matty's private GameEye export is an input only and must not be committed to this public repository.
Core completion is North American NES; Famicom is visible and collectible but excluded from the core completion percentage.
